description: Appointment Scheduling — let pet owners self-book vet visits online. New Appointment entity (separate from the existing completed-visit Visit entity), fixed Mon–Fri 9–5 30-minute slots, double-booking prevention, email confirmation, and a 24h reminder. Source PRD: tasks/prd-appointment-scheduling.md.

userStories.title: Add Appointment entity, repository, and DB schemas
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an Appointment domain entity persisted to the database so future appointments can be stored independently of historical Visit records.
acceptanceCriteria: Entity org.springframework.samples.petclinic.owner.Appointment extends BaseEntity with fields: pet (@ManyToOne → Pet), vet (@ManyToOne → Vet), startTime (LocalDateTime, @NotNull + @Future), durationMinutes (int, default 30), reason (String, @Size(max=255)), status enum (SCHEDULED/CANCELLED/COMPLETED, default SCHEDULED, @Enumerated(STRING)), createdAt (LocalDateTime set via @PrePersist)
AppointmentRepository extends JpaRepository<Appointment, Integer> with findByPetId, findByVetIdAndStartTimeBetween, findByStartTimeBetween (save/findById/delete inherited)

appointments table added to src/main/resources/db/h2/schema.sql, db/mysql/schema.sql, db/postgres/schema.sql with FKs to pets(id) and vets(id) and index on (vet_id, start_time); h2 DROP ordering updated so appointments drops before pets/vets
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)
userStories.notes: Completed 2026-05-19. Files: src/main/java/.../owner/Appointment.java, AppointmentRepository.java; schemas updated in h2, mysql, postgres. Maven + Gradle tests pass. Caveat: @Future on startTime runs on every JPA pre-update; switch to validation groups if a flow ever updates a past-time row (e.g. the fulfillment-as-Visit flow in PRD Open Questions §9). Comment noting this is in Appointment.java.

userStories.title: Slot computation service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that returns the available appointment slots for a given vet and date, so the UI can show only bookable times.
acceptanceCriteria: New AppointmentSlotService in org.springframework.samples.petclinic.owner with method List<LocalDateTime> availableSlots(int vetId, LocalDate date)
Working hours hardcoded as constants: Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, 30-minute slots; weekends return empty list
Excludes slots already taken by a SCHEDULED appointment for that vet (uses findByVetIdAndStartTimeBetween, filters status = SCHEDULED)
Excludes past slots when the requested date is today
Inject Clock for deterministic testing
Unit test covers: weekday with no bookings returns 16 slots; weekday with one booking returns 15; Saturday returns 0; today with current time after 14:00 returns only slots ≥ next half-hour
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)

userStories.title: Booking form — owner picks vet, date, time
userStories.description: As an owner, I want to book a future appointment for my pet by selecting a vet, a date, and an available time slot, so I don't have to call the clinic.
acceptanceCriteria: New AppointmentController exposes GET /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/appointments/new (render form) and POST same path (validate + persist; redirect to /owners/{ownerId} with flash message 'Your appointment is confirmed for <date> <time> with Dr. <vet>')
GET /api/appointments/slots?vetId={id}&date={yyyy-MM-dd} returns JSON [{"startTime":"...","label":"HH:mm"}] populating the slot dropdown via AJAX
Date picker defaults to tomorrow; weekends not selectable
Submitting a slot already taken re-renders the form with error 'That slot was just taken — please pick another.' (FR-5)
@InitBinder disallows id, *.id, status, createdAt (mirror VisitController pattern)
New Thymeleaf template src/main/resources/templates/appointments/createAppointmentForm.html reusing fragments/layout.html, inputField.html, selectField.html
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: happy-path booking; double-booking rejected; weekend dates not selectable

userStories.title: Owner-facing upcoming appointments list
userStories.description: As an owner, I want to see my pet's upcoming appointments on the owner details page so I know what's scheduled.
acceptanceCriteria: OwnerController loads upcoming SCHEDULED appointments for each of the owner's pets and exposes them on the model
src/main/resources/templates/owners/ownerDetails.html shows an 'Upcoming Appointments' section per pet (under or above the existing Visits table) with columns: date, time, vet, reason, Cancel button
If a pet has no upcoming appointments: section shows 'No upcoming appointments.' and a 'Book appointment' link to /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/appointments/new
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: owner with mixed pets (some with, some without appointments) renders correctly

userStories.title: Cancel an appointment
userStories.description: As an owner or staff member, I want to cancel an upcoming appointment so the slot is freed up.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/appointments/{appointmentId}/cancel sets status to CANCELLED and persists
AppointmentSlotService filters on status = SCHEDULED, so cancelled appointments no longer block slots
Cancelled appointments are hidden from the 'Upcoming Appointments' list (US-004)
Redirects to /owners/{ownerId} with flash message 'Appointment cancelled.'
Returns 404 if appointment does not belong to the given pet/owner
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: cancel an appointment, then confirm the slot is available again on the booking form

userStories.title: Reschedule an appointment
userStories.description: As an owner or staff member, I want to change the date/time/vet of an upcoming appointment without cancelling and rebooking.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/appointments/{appointmentId}/edit renders the booking form pre-filled with current vet, date, and slot
POST same path updates the appointment (only if status = SCHEDULED) with the same future-time and no-double-booking checks as creation, excluding the edited appointment from its own conflict check
Editing a non-SCHEDULED appointment redirects to the owner page with flash message 'Only scheduled appointments can be edited.'
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: edit a booking to a different vet/time and confirm the old slot is freed and the new one is taken

userStories.title: Staff appointment console
userStories.description: As clinic staff, I want a single page that lists all appointments for a given day across all vets so I can manage the schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /appointments (optional ?date=yyyy-MM-dd, default today) renders a daily schedule
Table grouped by vet with rows per slot; cells show pet name + owner name + reason, with edit and cancel links
Date navigation: 'Previous day' and 'Next day' links
Linked from the top nav (fragments/layout.html) as a new 'Appointments' menu item
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: navigate days; click edit/cancel actions

userStories.title: Add email column to owners
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an email field on Owner so confirmation/reminder emails have a recipient. (Split from PRD US-008.)
acceptanceCriteria: Add `email` column (optional, max 255) to owners in all three schemas: db/h2/schema.sql, db/mysql/schema.sql, db/postgres/schema.sql
Add `email` field to Owner.java with @Email and @Size(max=255) (no @NotBlank — optional)
src/main/resources/templates/owners/createOrUpdateOwnerForm.html gains an email input bound to owner.email
Existing OwnerControllerTests still pass; add a test covering save/load of email value
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: edit an owner, save an email, reload and confirm it persists

userStories.title: Add mail starter and AppointmentNotificationService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that can send confirmation and reminder emails so the booking flows can plug into it. (Split from PRD US-008.)
acceptanceCriteria: Add spring-boot-starter-mail dependency to both pom.xml and build.gradle
Create AppointmentNotificationService with methods sendConfirmation(Appointment) and sendReminder(Appointment); delegates to JavaMailSender; injects Clock
Confirmation subject: 'PetClinic appointment confirmed: <date> <time>'; body includes pet, vet, datetime, reason, cancellation link
Reminder subject: 'Reminder: PetClinic appointment tomorrow at <time>'
If Owner.email is blank: silently skip sending, log a warning, do not throw
Mail configured via spring.mail.* in application.properties from environment vars; test profile uses an in-memory / no-op JavaMailSender so tests do not hit the network
Unit test: JavaMailSender.send invoked exactly once with correct `to` address and non-empty body; second test verifies the blank-email branch skips sending
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)
userStories.notes: Split from PRD US-008. Depends on US-008a.

userStories.title: Wire notification service into booking and reschedule flows
userStories.description: As an owner, I want a confirmation email immediately on booking (and on reschedule) so I have a record of my appointment. (Split from PRD US-008.)
acceptanceCriteria: AppointmentController calls AppointmentNotificationService.sendConfirmation(...) after successful create (US-003) and after successful reschedule (US-006)
Failure of the email send must not roll back the booking — log the error and continue
Integration test: posting a booking causes one mail send with the booking's startTime and the owner's email
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)

Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: complete a booking with an owner that has an email; via the test mail sender's recorded messages (or a MailHog/local SMTP catcher), confirm an email was produced
userStories.notes: Split from PRD US-008. Depends on US-008a and US-008b.

userStories.title: Add reminder_sent column to appointments
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a flag on Appointment so the daily reminder job can mark which rows have already been notified. (Split from PRD US-009.)
acceptanceCriteria: Add reminder_sent boolean column (NOT NULL, default false) to appointments in all three schemas
Add `reminderSent` boolean field to Appointment.java with getter/setter; default false in field initializer
Existing tests still pass; add a test that creates an appointment, asserts reminderSent defaults to false, flips it, saves, reloads, and asserts true
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)

userStories.title: Scheduled 24h reminder job
userStories.description: As an owner, I want a reminder email roughly 24 hours before my appointment so I don't forget. (Split from PRD US-009.)
acceptanceCriteria: Add @EnableScheduling (new @Configuration class or on PetClinicApplication)

@Scheduled(cron = "0 0 9 * * *") job queries SCHEDULED appointments with reminder_sent = false and startTime between 24h and 48h from now (via injected Clock); calls AppointmentNotificationService.sendReminder for each; flips reminder_sent to true

Unit test with a fixed Clock asserts (a) the query window, (b) sendReminder is called once per matching appointment, (c) reminder_sent is true after the job, (d) re-running the job does not double-send
Build passes (mvn test and ./gradlew test)
userStories.notes: Split from PRD US-009. Depends on US-008b (notification service) and US-009a (reminder_sent column).
